categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jadard Technology Inc. focuses on integrated single-chip R&D, design, and sales in the mobile smart terminal field. Its main product lines include smart mobile terminal display driver chips (including TDDI), camera voice coil motor (VCM) driver chips, fast charging protocol chips, and electronic shelf label (ESL) driver chips. These products serve applications in smartphones, tablets, smart speakers, wearables, fast charging/power banks, smart retail, smart office, and smart healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor design technologies including LCD DDIC, TDDI (touch and display driver integration), and OLED DDIC for display drivers. It uses fabless manufacturing, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to leading foundries and packaging firms. Key innovations include dynamic brightness compensation for AMOLED, algorithm-based P-sensor replacement in TDDI, multi-color ESL driver ICs, USB PD 3.2 fast charging protocol chips, and closed-loop VCM driver chips for optical image stabilization. The company holds 72 patents and 229 intellectual property rights, emphasizing R&D and product iteration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major downstream customers including panel manufacturers (BOE, Innolux, CSOT), module makers, system integrators, and end brands such as Samsung, VIVO, OPPO, Honor, Amazon, Google, Baidu, Xiaomi, 360, TikTok, and others. Its products are widely used in mobile phones, tablets, smart speakers, wearables, fast charging devices, smart retail, smart office, and healthcare sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Mainland China, Hong Kong, and international markets. The company has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Hefei, China. Revenue is split between domestic and export markets, with significant sales in China and overseas. The company maintains supply chain partnerships primarily with domestic wafer foundries and packaging/testing firms.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jadard operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and packaging vendors. It is positioned midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, bridging upstream manufacturing and downstream module/system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology and product innovation with sustained R&D investment (8.36% of revenue in 2024). Strategic R&D focuses on high-integration, high-resolution, low-power display driver ICs, multi-interface TDDI chips, AMOLED driver optimization, multi-color ESL chips, advanced fast charging protocol chips supporting USB PD 3.2 and UFCS standards, and closed-loop VCM driver chips for optical image stabilization. It aims to expand product lines, accelerate iteration, deepen customer collaboration, and enhance market share through differentiated technology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor chips including display drivers, camera motor drivers, fast charging protocol chips, and ESL driver chips. The company sells mainly via distributors with some direct sales to end customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control at delivery or customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the semiconductor display driver and related chip markets with competitors such as Jinghong Semiconductor and Jingmen Technology in ESL chips. It holds a leading global market share in four-color ESL driver ICs and is expanding its footprint in mobile display drivers and fast charging chips. The company leverages technology innovation and customer relationships to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved RMB 2.1 billion in revenue, a 73.88% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 274.88 million, up 143.61%. R&D expenses increased by 22.20% to RMB 175.75 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.57 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.18 billion, reflecting strong growth and expanding scale. Earnings per share rose to RMB 0.68 from RMB 0.28 in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jadard emphasizes differentiated products with advanced technology integration, such as dynamic brightness compensation for AMOLED, algorithmic P-sensor replacement in TDDI to reduce costs, and multi-color ESL driver ICs with broad temperature adaptability and low power consumption. Its closed-loop VCM driver chips offer superior optical image stabilization at lower cost and power. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and stable quality underpin its value proposition of high-performance, cost-effective semiconductor solutions tailored for diverse smart terminal applications.
